method: One homepage per site, fetched once per identity from the same machine within seconds, changing only the client identity. Nothing bypassed, nothing logged in. Sites that refuse the browser control are marked not_comparable and left out of the denominator, because refusing every non browser client is a different thing from refusing agents.
